title: Constrain the pure Engram grant-clear validation escape hatch
outcome: The pure-authority-clear path skips home and enablement validation so an enabled Engram configuration with a missing or non-absolute home may remain persisted after the grant is removed. Preserve the ability to revoke authority when dependencies are unavailable without leaving an ambiguous enabled configuration.
acceptance: Pure grant clear remains possible when cleanup dependencies are unavailable, but the resulting enabled/home state follows one documented invariant (validated or forced disabled); tests cover missing and non-absolute homes and current revoke behavior.
